title: OKX林慧仪：代币化权益资产已占8%交易量，AI代理是下一站？
speaker: Gracie Lin

segments.en: Well, many markets, so so we've seen a demand for tokenized real-world assets, and it's global, it's not just Australia.
segments.zh: 许多市场对代币化现实世界资产有需求，这是全球性的，不仅限于澳大利亚。

segments.en: I mean, even IMF themselves are not talking about how quickly that space has grown and how much of that trading and tokenized equities
segments.zh: 就连IMF也在讨论该领域增长之快，以及多少代币化权益资产交易发生在市场时间之外。

segments.en: is happening outside of market hours. So the demand is there, everybody sees it, everybody recognizes it.
segments.zh: 需求确实存在，大家都看到了，也都认可。

segments.en: We've seen it, we've heard it from our clients. So we've launched products like tokenized equities in some markets.
segments.zh: 我们从客户那里看到并听到了这一点，因此已在一些市场推出了代币化权益资产等产品。

segments.en: So in Europe now, we have tokenized equities. And very quickly in just a few months, we're already seeing spot tokenized equity volume,
segments.zh: 现在在欧洲，我们已有代币化权益资产。短短几个月内，现货代币化权益资产的交易量已经...

segments.en: now making almost 8% of our global spot trading volume, which is significant thinking that it's only been a few months compared with our crypto history.
segments.zh: 目前已占我们全球现货交易量的近8%，考虑到相比加密历史仅几个月，这很显著。

segments.en: So that's one big area of focus, of course. And then I'm sure you've heard about our OKX.
segments.zh: 所以这当然是一个重点领域。然后，我相信你听说过我们的OKX。

segments.en: ICE, joint venture, what we are doing for US investors in that part of the world.
segments.zh: ICE合资企业，我们为美国市场参与者在该地区所做的工作。

segments.en: So that's on the tokenized real-world asset space. We also care, we also believe in AI, agency commas, we believe is going to be the next big thing.
segments.zh: 这就是代币化现实世界资产领域。我们也关心并相信AI代理，我们认为这将是下一个大事件。

segments.en: So in June, we launched our OKX marketplace, which is a marketplace for agents.
segments.zh: 因此，在6月，我们推出了OKX市场，这是一个代理市场。

segments.en: Because we believe that with each person, now we're going to have more agents in a world potentially than humans, because we know that each human will have multiple agents
segments.zh: 因为我们相信，未来每个人拥有的智能代理数量可能超过人类，每个个体都会有多个代理

segments.en: doing different things for us. And then these agents have to go and interact with other agents to procure our services, give services, make payments, receive payments.
segments.zh: 为我们处理不同事务。这些代理需要与其他代理交互，以获取服务、提供服务、完成支付和收款。

segments.en: So all of those things we believe in, and that's why we are investing heavily in our agency marketplace as well.
segments.zh: 我们坚信这些趋势，因此也在大力布局代理市场。

segments.en: Is there independence that scares me?
segments.zh: 这种独立性会让我担心吗？
